title: Zerumbone, a humulane sesquiterpene from Syringa pinnatifolia, attenuates cardiac fibrosis by inhibiting of the TGF-beta1/Smad signaling pathway after myocardial infarction in mice.
authors: Li, Junjun; Ge, Fuxing; Wuken, Shana; Jiao, Shungang; Chen, Panlong; Huang, Meiwen; Gao, Xiaoli; Liu, Juan; Tu, Pengfei; Chai, Xingyun; Huang, Luqi
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Zerumbone通过TGF-beta1/Smad信号通路抑制心肌纤维化，仅用分子对接预测小分子与蛋白结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Zerumbone (ZER) is a humulane sesquiterpene isolated from Syringa pinnatifolia Hemsl., a representative Mongolian herbal medicine that is used to treat cardiovascular diseases. Cardiac fibrosis is a common pathological process in cardiovascular disease that results from the excessive accumulation of extracellular matrix (ECM), and the transforming growth factor (TGF)-beta/Smad pathway is a canonical signaling pathway that directly induces expressions of ECM-related genes. Currently, the cardioprotective effect and underlying mechanisms of ZER on the inhibition of cardiac fibrosis are not well known. PURPOSE: To explore the cardioprotective properties and pharmacological mechanism of ZER against cardiac fibrosis via the TGF-beta1/Smad signaling pathway. METHODS: Myocardial infarction (MI) model was induced by ligation of the left anterior descending coronary artery in ICR mice. The mice were randomly divided into six groups: sham, model, low-dose ZER (ZER-L), medium-dose ZER (ZER-M), high-dose ZER (ZER-H) and fosinopril. Mice in each group were intragastrically administered treatments for 21 days, and cardiac function was evaluated by 2D echocardiography. The pathological structure of the heart was examined by hematoxylin and eosin (HE) and Masson staining. Content of collagen I and collagen III were assessed by immunofluorescence methods. The inhibitory effect of ZER on TGF-beta1 protein expression was predicted by molecular docking technology. Reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) and western blotting were used to measure the levels of genes and proteins expressed in the TGF-beta1/Smad signaling pathway and MMPs. TGF-beta1-treated cardiac fibroblasts (CFs) of neonatal SD rats were adopted for in vitro studies. RESULTS: Cardiac ejection fraction (EF) and fractional shortening (FS) in the model group were markedly decreased compared with those in the sham group, indicating that the MI model was successfully established. ZER and fosinopril elevated EF and FS values, suggesting cardioprotective effects. Pathological staining and immunofluorescence analysis showed that the content of collagen I and collagen III increased in the cardiac tissue of mice in model group, while ZER treatment obviously reduced collagen levels. The molecular docking simulations predicted the hydrophobic interactions between ZER and TGF-beta1. In addition, the expression of TGF-beta1, p-Smad2/3 and MMPs in the ZER treatment group was significantly decreased compared with the model group. In vitro studies further confirmed that alpha-smooth muscle actin (alpha-SMA) and p-Smad2/3 increased markedly in cardiac fibroblasts after incubation with TGF-beta1, and treatment with ZER suppressed the expression of alpha-SMA and TGF-beta1 downstream proteins in cardiac fibroblasts. CONCLUSION: ZER rescues cardiac function by attenuating cardiac fibrosis, and the antifibrotic effect may be mediated by blocking the TGF-beta1/Smad pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：Zerumbone（ZER）是一种从蒙古代表性草药丁香蓼（Syringa pinnatifolia Hemsl.）中分离出的蛇麻烯倍半萜，该草药用于治疗心血管疾病。心脏纤维化是心血管疾病中常见的病理过程，由细胞外基质（ECM）过度积累引起，而转化生长因子（TGF）-β/Smad通路是直接诱导ECM相关基因表达的经典信号通路。目前，ZER对抑制心脏纤维化的心脏保护作用及其潜在机制尚不清楚。目的：探讨ZER通过TGF-β1/Smad信号通路对心脏纤维化的心脏保护特性及药理机制。方法：通过结扎ICR小鼠左前降支冠状动脉诱导心肌梗死（MI）模型。将小鼠随机分为六组：假手术组、模型组、低剂量ZER组（ZER-L）、中剂量ZER组（ZER-M）、高剂量ZER组（ZER-H）和福辛普利组。每组小鼠灌胃给药21天，并通过二维超声心动图评估心脏功能。采用苏木精-伊红（HE）和Masson染色检查心脏病理结构。通过免疫荧光方法评估I型胶原和III型胶原含量。利用分子对接技术预测ZER对TGF-β1蛋白表达的抑制作用。采用逆转录聚合酶链反应（RT-PCR）和蛋白质印迹法测量TGF-β1/Smad信号通路及MMPs中基因和蛋白的表达水平。体外研究采用TGF-β1处理的新生SD大鼠心脏成纤维细胞（CFs）。结果：与假手术组相比，模型组的心脏射血分数（EF）和缩短分数（FS）显著降低，表明MI模型成功建立。ZER和福辛普利提高了EF和FS值，提示具有心脏保护作用。病理染色和免疫荧光分析显示，模型组小鼠心脏组织中I型胶原和III型胶原含量增加，而ZER处理明显降低了胶原水平。分子对接模拟预测了ZER与TGF-β1之间的疏水相互作用。此外，与模型组相比，ZER处理组中TGF-β1、p-Smad2/3和MMPs的表达显著降低。体外研究进一步证实，TGF-β1孵育后心脏成纤维细胞中α-平滑肌肌动蛋白（α-SMA）和p-Smad2/3显著增加，而ZER处理抑制了心脏成纤维细胞中α-SMA和TGF-β1下游蛋白的表达。结论：ZER通过减轻心脏纤维化来恢复心脏功能，其抗纤维化作用可能通过阻断TGF-β1/Smad通路介导。
